scope: Where the Rust rewrite's structure still differs from the Go owner it ports, from the 2026-11-23 symbol-level re-audit (method in structural-audit-2026-11-23.md).

findings.finding: Pipelined DML is not ported: `tidb_dml_type='bulk'` runs a standard transaction; Go's `usePipelinedDmlOrWarn` (fallback warnings for temporary tables, `tidb_constraint_check_in_place=ON`, explicit transactions, ...) and the pipelined transaction are missing. A Go server reports `pipelined:true` in `tidb_last_txn_info` after a bulk INSERT; this one reports `false` and no warnings.

`performance_schema` virtual tables return no rows: `session_connect_attrs`, `session_account_connect_attrs`, the `tidb_profile_*` tables, and the `tikv_profile_cpu` / `pd_profile_*` remote profiles. Go `perfSchemaTable.getRows` fills them (Go answers 3 connect attributes and non-empty goroutine / memory profiles).

`tidb_auth_token` authentication is not ported: no `GlobalJWKS` (`security.auth-token-jwks`, `auth-token-refresh-interval`), no JWT signature check (`JWKSImpl.checkSigWithRetry`) or claims check (`checkAuthTokenClaims`); such accounts cannot log in.
findings.rust_evidence: `tidb-session/src/domain/configured_user_store.rs:712` refuses: "Go verifies a JWT against `GlobalJWKS`; this server has none".

findings.finding: `consistency.Reporter` is not ported: admin-check and lookup inconsistencies build their errors ad hoc and never log Go's `admin check found data inconsistency` / `indexLookup found data inconsistency` records with the row and index MVCC (`GetMvccByKey`, `DecodeRowMvccData`, `DecodeIndexMvccData`) under the redaction mode.

findings.group: Structure: Go's shape before more ports
findings.finding: Go `pkg/planner/optimize.go` (`Optimize`, `optimizeNoCache`, `optimize`, `buildLogicalPlan`, `buildAndOptimizeLogicalPlanRound` and the alternative-round predicates, `OptimizeForForeignKeyCascade`, `queryPlanCost`, `genBriefPlanWithSCtx`) has no planner-side owner: it lives in the executor.

Partition pruning is not Go's `partitionProcessor`: Go prunes over the conditions in the logical rule (`processRangePartition` / `processListPartition` / `processHashOrKeyPartition`, `rangePruner`, `listPartitionPruner`); Rust prunes from ranger intervals through an executor-side callback, with LIST COLUMNS locating in the executor.
Planner code owned by the executor: `pb_to_plan.go` (`PBPlanBuilder`), the plan-cache utilities and cacheable checker, and `rule_collect_plan_stats.go`'s statistics loading live in `tidb-executor`.
Go's `expressionRewriter` (`pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go`) and `ScalarSubQueryExpr` are split into the expression crate instead of the planner.

findings.group: Structure: Go's shape before more ports
findings.finding: `SessionVars`' typed fields are not on the session variables: the executor re-parses the variable table into a per-generation snapshot (66 `SessionVars` fields) instead of each variable's `SetSession` hook maintaining a field.

The analyze-job lifecycle (`insertAnalyzeJob`, `startAnalyzeJob`, `updateAnalyzeJobProgress`, `finishAnalyzeJob`) lives in the session crate behind an executor trait instead of the autoanalyze handle.
Login verification (`ConnectionVerification`'s plugin, password, lock and TLS checks) is split between the session crate and the privilege crate.
